g.text: Common Variable Immunodeficiency (CVID) — 보통 가변 면역결핍증
QSP mechanistic map · ARM 1 antibody deficiency (replaceable) ∥ ARM 2 immune dysregulation (not replaceable) → irreversible structure

g.title: NOTE_ARM2
g.text: ARM 2 — why replacement is not enough
Chapel 2008 defined five mutually near-exclusive phenotypes:
Every ARM 2 drug on this map costs net immunosuppression,
which loops straight back into ARM 1. That loop —
second of the model's four trade-offs.

g.title: NOTE_RATCHET
g.text: THE RATCHET — why timing beats dose
colonisation → IL-8 → neutrophil elastase → wall destruction
A positive feedback loop with an irreversible state inside it.
Two patients with the identical steady-state trough have
permanently different FEV1 if one was diagnosed at year 1
and the other at year 7. Replacement stops the ratchet;
Consequence: the most valuable intervention in CVID is not a
better immunoglobulin. It is an earlier serum IgG measurement.
